• Faster start-up, smoother chats and lower data use
• More reliable relay connections and message sync
• Clear errors when a message, zap or ecash fails to send
• Images and voice messages retry and explain failures
• New NApps, including Nostrord, and a "Disabled" notification sound
• Amber no longer has to reconnect on every start
• A failed login no longer signs you out
• Security and privacy fixes for Cashu, gift-wrapped DMs, the in-app browser and Tor/proxy connections
